manifest.purpose: Reference correct recovery: module recovered_design(input [15:0] a,b,c,d, output [31:0] sum) implementing sum = a+b+c+d as pure word-level combinational RTL: assign sum = {16'b0,a} + {16'b0,b} + {16'b0,c} + {16'b0,d}; (or equivalent tree ((a+b)+(c+d))). Single self-contained file, no includes, no clock/reset, no instantiation of primitive_cells.v or flattened_netlist.v. Must satisfy FR1-FR4: bit-exact match vs inputs/flattened_netlist.v for FR2 vectors (0x0001+0x0002+0x0003+0x0004=0xA; 0xFFFF*4=0x3FFFC) and all randomized/corner vectors, compiles cleanly with iverilog, purely combinational, passes SR1 structural gate (no gate-primitive instances, not a copy of flattened_netlist.v).
